:::{#def-training-mse}
#### Training error (empirical risk on the training set)

The **training error**, also called the **empirical [risk](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-risk) on the [training set](#def-training-set)**, of a [prediction rule](#def-fitted-model) $\fitted$
fitted to a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is its sample mean [loss](#def-observation-loss) $\obsloss{\iobs}$
on the training observations $\iobs \in \obsidx$:

$$
\trainerr \eqdef \avgin \obsloss{\iobs}.
$$ {#eq-training-mse}

:::

:::{#rem-source-training-mse}
#### Source: Training error

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.2], who write the training error as $\overline{\text{err}}$
and define it for any loss.

:::
